propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` flags to accept a date range, and `--output json|text` to select output format.

The metrics command must enumerate every `MetricSpec` in the hydrated `REGISTRY` via `evaluate(spec, context)` and render all metrics over the full `[since, until]` range without per-bucket bucketing.

The command must construct a context object with `repo_root`, `since`, and `until` attributes and pass it to `evaluate`, with fault isolation wrapping each evaluate call to render exceptions as unavailable metrics instead of crashing the command.

Registry hydration must occur via `import rebar.metrics` (the package) to trigger reader registration side-effects; the command source must not import `rebar.metrics.adapters` directly (verified by source-level scan).

JSON output format is `{"since": <str>, "until": <str>, "metrics": {<id>: {"lens","source","confidence","value"} | {"unavailable": {"reason","accruing_since"}}, ...}}`; text output is one deterministic line per metric in registry order showing `<id> [<lens>/<source>] <value-or-"unavailable: <reason>">`.

The command must be routed via an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm in `_dispatch()`, listed in the `individual` frozenset in `test_help_overview_coverage.py`, advertised in `help/overview.txt`, and have golden help and CLI-reference snapshots regenerated.
